::: {.page-lead}
I work at the intersection of generative modeling, latent world models,
reinforcement learning, and numerical methods, with the aim of building
general-purpose robots that learn and adapt in real settings. I completed the
M2 Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay in 2026,
and the coursework of CentraleSupélec's Engineering Degree in Mathematics and
Data Science, which is conferred after the December 2026 jury.
:::

From January 2027, I join Yuejiang Liu's LEMA group at the National University
of Singapore for a six-month research position in robot learning.

From September 2025 to September 2026, alongside my studies, I worked as a
Generative AI Engineer at MBDA on multi-agent systems built around large
language models. I previously worked as a Data Scientist at TotalEnergies'
Digital Factory. This site covers only public research and deliberately
excludes non-public professional work.
